card.name: Timing words in monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: Small timing words such as during, at and of that link a monitoring or stopping instruction to a treatment period. Most often seen in advice on testing glucose or blood counts.

modes.label: During treatment
modes.description: The word during after a monitoring verb or phrase, right before treatment or therapy.
modes.example: should undergo fasting blood glucose testing at the beginning of treatment and periodically<< during>> treatment.

modes.label: At or of in timing phrases
modes.description: The words at or of in phrases about when to stop or test, such as at least or at the beginning.
modes.example: Amiloride and hydrochlorothiazide should be discontinued<< at>> least three days before glucose tolerance testing.

card.plain: It marks small words that say when to monitor or stop a drug, such as during treatment.
